page: Amazon Web Services r9g.24xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features custom AWS-designed arm64 processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance provisions 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 virtual CPUs with a single thread per core, eliminating performance interference associated with simultaneous multithreading.

The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per core ratio. It contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network throughput features a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps without bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Dedicated hardware accelerators or discrete GPUs are not included.

With its large memory capacity and dedicated arm64 core configuration, the r9g.24xlarge is structured for memory-intensive workloads that can run on ARM architectures. The 1:8 core-to-memory ratio aligns with in-memory caching layers, large relational or distributed databases, and high-throughput data processing pipelines. Systems that rely strictly on local NVMe storage or x86 instruction sets require architectural adjustments or alternative configurations.
